description: Governance proposals on one network or every one: the latest, those in one status (open for votes, opening soon, passed, rejected, other outcomes), or one proposal in full with its text, tally and (on Cosmos networks) how each validator voted.

network.description: A network slug from list-networks. Default: every network with governance (not with "proposal").

open.description: The same as status "open". Default: the latest 10.

proposal.description: One proposal's number, for it in full (needs "network").

status.description: Only proposals in this status, the same on every network: open (taking votes, soonest to close first), soon (opening soon), passed, rejected or other. Default: any.

name: governance-proposals
title: Governance proposals
